use_case.statement: A user of the scalar 5D result tests neutrino-interaction models of how the hadronic final state (available energy E_avail and hadronic invariant mass W) depends on the momentum transfer (q3) and on the muon kinematics (pT, p_parallel), at a coarse joint resolution: the strength and location of two-particle-two-hole (2p2h) and resonance contributions, pion final-state interactions, and the high-E_avail/high-W region where every tested generator lies below the data. The user needs (i) cross sections in coarse joint cells with total uncertainties they can propagate (a covariance or a declared bounded component), (ii) the (E_avail, W) projection as the reporting product of the paper, and (iii) a calibrated joint comparison with fixed generator predictions that has stated power against physically sized differences in the joint dependence, not only in the (E_avail, W) marginal.
use_case.scale_of_relevant_differences: the committed development departures, each a traceable difference between two fixed generator predictions reweighted onto the analysis MC truth (stage-1 receipt, departure_rel): per reported J cell the median |truth change| is 3.7% (GENIE MEC / CV in (E_avail,W)), 7.7% (NuWro / GENIE in (pT,p_parallel,E_avail)), 10.0% (NuWro / GENIE in E_avail) and 16.0% (GiBUU / GENIE in E_avail); the 90th percentiles are 7.9-27.1%; in H2 cells the medians are 4.0-5.9%. The integrated cross sections of the fixed generators lie 19-28% below the data (VL35-VL38), so total-rate and shape-only comparisons are kept distinct.
use_case.why_joint: the q3-conditional and muon-kinematic dependences of the hadronic response are where generator models differ at fixed (E_avail, W) (the mechanism of 2p2h and resonance models depends on (q0, q3)); an (E_avail, W)-only comparison cannot see them

predictions.MnvTune_v1: GENIE 2.12.6 with the MINERvA Tune v1 weights: the analysis MC itself (event-level, all five coordinates; it is also the unfolding prior, which is recorded, not hidden)
predictions.GENIE_2_12_10_CV: untuned GENIE 2.12.10 on CH without 2p2h (gst event files under /pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/MINERvA-OmniFold/3d-unfolding/genie/)
predictions.GENIE_2_12_10_MEC: the same with the Valencia 2p2h component added (a configuration of the same generator, a separate hypothesis and never an independent confirmation)
predictions.NuWro_21_09: NuWro 21.09 on carbon (event files; q3 needs a re-run of the flat conversion from the raw output)
predictions.GiBUU_2019: GiBUU 2019 on carbon (FinalEvents.dat; q3 from the stored neutrino energy and muon 4-momentum)

generator_comparisons.status: only MnvTune v1 exists on the joint 5D domain today; the four other 5D predictions are constructed at Stage 7 (with input identities, finite-MC uncertainties, flux and target conventions of the existing 3D/(E_avail,W) comparisons) before any observed test; a generator whose 5D prediction cannot be built is recorded as not tested
generator_comparisons.nulls: for each prediction G separately: H0(G): the true cross sections of the reported joint cells equal G's. Two tests per G: total (rate and shape) and shape-only (normalized to the measured total in the reporting domain). The family is the 5 predictions x 2 tests per reporting definition; rejection claims use Holm at familywise 0.05 over that family, and raw and adjusted p-values are both reported

nuisance_domain.physical_nuisances_of_the_measurement: flux (MINERvA flux universes), detector (muon energy scale and resolution, beam angle, MINOS efficiency, GEANT hadron reweights, the five selection-complete lateral bands), background model (template MC statistics and the background cross-section model through the per-universe background weights), GENIE cross-section model knobs as they enter efficiency and migrations (vertical universes), MC statistics, the estimator's numerical sensitivity, and the estimator's regularization (unfolding-model) dependence on the true shape
nuisance_domain.for_the_generator_tests: flux, detector, background and MC statistics are nuisances; GENIE cross-section knobs are NOT nuisances of a fixed-generator null (the null specifies the physics); the regularization bias under H0(G) is carried by simulating the complete procedure at G's truth rather than by an allowance
nuisance_domain.treatment: each nuisance is declared probabilistic, profiled or deterministic-bounded at Stage 3, with nuisance-averaged versus uniform composite-null calibration stated

power_alternatives.P1_muon_hadronic: the NuWro/GENIE (pT, p_parallel, E_avail) shape ratio (the W3 construction) applied multiplicatively to the null truth: a change of the muon-kinematic dependence at fixed E_avail, beyond the (E_avail,W) marginal
power_alternatives.P2_q3_conditional: a q3-conditional change at fixed (E_avail, W), anchored to a traceable generator difference in the q3 dependence (GiBUU/GENIE or NuWro/GENIE conditional q3 shape, built at Stage 3 from the event samples; not the unanchored q3 a = 0.3 stress), preserving the (E_avail,W) marginal numerically
power_alternatives.P3_2p2h: the GENIE MEC / CV (E_avail, W) shape ratio (the W2 construction), a 2p2h-sized change
power_alternatives.amplitudes: a = 1 (the anchored generator difference) and a = 0.5; power is required at a = 1 and reported at both
power_alternatives.admissibility: each alternative must lie outside the tested null including its nuisance variations after detector response: its expected reco-level imprint must exceed what the declared flux/detector nuisances can mimic (checked at Stage 3 with the nuisance model); an indistinguishable alternative cannot qualify the power target
power_alternatives.note: P1 and P3 have been observed on development experiments (s5e W3, W2); they are power alternatives (named physics directions), not withheld measurement-validation truths

T1_total_width.rule: median over reported cells of the total relative 68% half-width <= 10%, and 90th percentile <= 25%
T1_total_width.justification: the NuWro/GENIE and GiBUU/GENIE cell differences (median 8-16%) are then 1-1.6 total sigma per typical cell, so the joint comparison can resolve them; a band wider than this cannot distinguish the named generators and is not a precision result
T1_total_width.retrospective_motivation: the adopted C_EW total sigma (median 8.4% over EW cells, s5e assess_receipt A4) set the scale that a total-uncertainty measurement on this data can reach

T2_bias_control.rule: on each declared development physical alternative (GiBUU E_avail, W1 NuWro E_avail, W2 GENIE MEC (E_avail,W), W3 NuWro 3D, and the Stage-3 anchored q3-conditional alternative), the median over reported cells with a departure > 1% of |bias| / |departure| <= 0.25 (the estimator recovers >= 75% of a generator-sized departure in a typical cell); and the declared unfolding-model component has a median <= 5% relative over reported cells
T2_bias_control.justification: a comparison whose cells move by less than three quarters of a true generator difference is mostly a statement about the unfolding prior; 5% keeps the model component below the non-model total uncertainty scale of T1
T2_bias_control.retrospective_motivation: stage-1 receipt: R at 5 iterations recovers a median 0.36-0.86 of the departures on J cells (0.67-0.89 on H2) and its J-cell bias medians are 0.56-9.29% (s5e K2/K3/W1-W3); R at 5 iterations FAILS this target on J, which motivated it; it is a target for successor configurations, not a regrading of R

T3_numerical.rule: the SD of each reported functional under the declared rounding-scale input perturbation <= 0.2 x its total sigma in the median over reported functionals and <= 0.5 x at the maximum; AND the numerical component is contained in the reported uncertainty, either shown to be absorbed by the refit-per-replica bootstrap (the Stage-2 paired design with its measured cross term) or added as a declared independent component
T3_numerical.justification: a reproducibility spread below a fifth of the total uncertainty does not change any use of the result; containment keeps the interval honest
T3_numerical.retrospective_motivation: s5e A3 FAILED (rounding moved data functionals 0.78 median / 2.58 max data-STATISTICAL sigma, a 0.2% / 1% relative spread); the replacement rescales the same measured quantity to the TOTAL sigma of the measurement being reported; A3 stays a FAIL for s5e

T4_coverage.rule: total 68% and 95% intervals, every reported functional and every fresh validation truth point: one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bound, Bonferroni over (functionals x points) at familywise 95%, >= 0.60 (68%) and >= 0.90 (95%); a pooled pass cannot certify a failing functional
T4_coverage.justification: both thresholds are crossed when the total sigma is underestimated by about 19% (68%: 0.60 = coverage of +-sigma/1.19; 95%: 0.90 = coverage of +-1.96 sigma/1.19), the smallest mis-statement of the total uncertainty that would change a user's inference materially; over-coverage is bounded by T1 instead
T4_coverage.retrospective_motivation: the plan section 7 bounds 0.66/0.94 need n ~ 11,400-17,700 experiments per point for 80% assurance even at exactly nominal coverage (s5e next_design.json), which no pool here can pay, and they test statistical-only intervals; this replacement tests total intervals

T5_statistical_calibration.rule: at nominal truth on development and on fresh experiments, the per-functional pull SD of the statistical component lies within [0.80, 1.25] for every reported functional (simultaneous chi-square bounds at the frozen sample size), and every reported functional's mean pull is within its 99.9% band
T5_statistical_calibration.justification: the statistical component enters the total; a 25% scale error is the largest that leaves T4 attainable when statistics are a minor component, and the failing cells must be explained or corrected
T5_statistical_calibration.retrospective_motivation: s5e A2: six functionals outside 1 +- 3 SE repeating between development and assessment (EW41 pull SD 1.42)

T6_joint_test.rule: for each null, size at alpha = 0.05 validated (verified finite-sample route or empirical: simultaneous one-sided 95% upper bound on the rejection fraction <= 0.08 over the declared null scenarios); power >= 0.80 at alpha = 0.05 against P1 and P3 at a = 1 and against P2 at a = 1 (95% lower bound reported beside the estimate); the test's numerical/rounding spread <= 0.1 of the SD of its null distribution
T6_joint_test.justification: a test that detects anchored generator-sized joint differences four times in five is useful for model selection; weaker power is reported as a limitation, never as agreement
T6_joint_test.retrospective_motivation: none of these was measured before; the 0.08 bound replaces the plan's 0.06 because the plan's bound needs ~2,000 validation experiments per null scenario

T7_p_value_precision.rule: Monte Carlo p-values (k+1)/(B+1) with exact 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals for the tail probability; required half-width <= 0.05 for p >= 0.05 and <= 0.5 p for 0.01 <= p < 0.05; below 0.01 only a one-sided bound at its actual confidence; a p-value whose interval straddles 0.05 or 0.01 is reported as undetermined at that level; a valid sequential stopping rule (Besag-Clifford) may replace a fixed B if frozen at Stage 3
T7_p_value_precision.justification: the use is decision-making at the 0.05 and 0.01 levels within a Holm family, plus a descriptive p; three-digit precision on a large p changes no decision
T7_p_value_precision.retrospective_motivation: the plan's +-0.005 for p >= 0.05 needs B ~ 38,000 null experiments per test (s5c feasibility receipt: all inference infeasible), which motivated the change

RD1_J.cells: the 109 supported cells of the s5c partition J (H3: pt [0, 0.55, 0.85, 4.5], pz [1.5, 3.5, 6, 60], E_avail [0, 0.4, 1.5, 100], q3 [0, 1.2, 2, 100], W [0, 1.4, 2.2, 100] GeV; unsupported cells stay in the total), plus the (E_avail,W) projection (42 fine cells; 39 meet the support rule, EW11, EW36, EW37 do not and are reported as in the adopted product with that flag) and the total in the domain
RD1_J.physics: the finest partition with marginal purity and stability >= 0.5 on every axis (s5c rule); stage-1 receipt: joint purity median 0.14, background fraction median 2.3% (max 11.2%), reco-passing fraction median 0.68

RD2_H2.cells: the supported cells of the 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 partition (pt [0, 0.7, 4.5], pz [1.5, 4.5, 60], E_avail [0, 0.8, 100], q3 [0, 2, 100], W [0, 1.8, 100] GeV): 27 of 32 meet the support rule (cells 2, 6, 10, 14, 17 do not and stay in the total), plus the total
RD2_H2.physics: the coarsest partition that still subdivides every coordinate; joint purity median 0.31; regularization residuals smaller than J's at 5 iterations (stage-1 receipt)

RD3_EW.cells: the (E_avail, W) projection alone (42 cells; 39 supported) and the total
RD3_EW.physics: the paper's reporting product and the lower-dimensional fallback: it qualifies separately and can never fulfil the joint-5D objective

reporting_definitions.support_rule: a cell is reported iff its expected reco-level signal and truth-selected weight at data POT are both >= 1000 (the s5c partition-J rule, applied unchanged to RD2 and RD3)
reporting_definitions.unfolding_domain: unchanged: the full fine 5D grid of the analysis (the unfolding runs on every event in the analysis window; reporting cells are aggregated after unfolding, so boundary migrations stay inside the unfolding domain)
reporting_definitions.fiducial_definition: unchanged (no narrower estimand is proposed; selection, normalization, flux and systematics keep their current definitions)

reporting_selection_procedure: after Stage 2 and the Stage-3 construction studies, on development and construction operands only, with the selected estimator: RD1 is selected if it meets T1, T2, T3 and T5; otherwise RD2 if it does; otherwise RD3 alone, with the joint-5D objective recorded unmet. RD3 is always reported beside RD1 or RD2 as the paper's projection. Cells are never added or removed by their residuals; the selection is locked in the Stage-3 admission record before any fresh validation seed

initial_joint_design.statistic: a quadratic residual statistic on the selected joint reporting cells, T = r' V^-1 r with r = f_hat - mu_G, V a FIXED matrix (the probabilistic part of the measurement covariance plus G's finite-MC covariance), cells few enough (<= 109) that V is inverted directly without a pseudoinverse cutoff; bounded or profiled components enter by a declared minimization over their bounded parameters; the shape-only form normalizes f_hat and mu_G to their totals and uses the corresponding projected V
initial_joint_design.calibration: simulation of the complete procedure under H0(G): event-level background-inclusive pseudo-experiments with the truth reweighted to G's reporting-cell prediction (within-cell shape conditional on MnvTune v1, declared), the estimator, the background refinement and the statistic recomputed per experiment, nuisances drawn from their declared priors (nuisance-averaged calibration, declared as such) or bounded/profiled; Monte Carlo p-value (k+1)/(B+1)
initial_joint_design.operands: calibration and validation ensembles in the separate stage-7 seed ranges; measurement-validation experiments are not reused for inference unless the admission record justifies it
open_design_questions_for_stage_3: the finite-sample route versus empirical size validation (exchangeability of the split-MC pseudo-experiment and the real-data procedure is not assumed)
how flux/detector nuisances enter null experiments at event level versus a validated linear surrogate
cost at the selected configuration and the precision tier that fits

data_informed_choices_inventory: the observed data, the high-E_avail/high-W localization and every earlier campaign's observed statistics were examined before this freeze; nothing in this campaign is blind

RD1 and RD2 are the s5c partition-scan levels (development MC, chosen by support/resolution rules written in s5c); RD2's inclusion was motivated by its smaller development residuals at 5 iterations (stage-1 receipt), i.e. by development pseudo-experiments, not by observed data
T1-T7 were written after reading the s5c, s5n and s5e results named in each retrospective_motivation; T2 and T3 are motivated by R's failures and are not claimed to be uninformed
the generator list is the paper's (paper_body.tex:169-190; VL35-VL38) plus MnvTune v1; it was not chosen by observed disagreement
the data-bootstrap widths read by the stage-1 script (R on data, 100 replicas, s5e) are widths only; no observed central value or generator comparison was computed here
